sourceDocuments.title: Architectural Patterns for Low-Bandwidth Web Systems
sourceDocuments.text: Intermittent grid electricity and high cellular data costs in sub-Saharan African educational environments necessitate offline-first progressive web applications utilizing Service Workers and IndexedDB local caching.

studentDocument.title: Offline Resilient Systems in African Higher Education
studentDocument.text: Due to frequent power failures and expensive mobile bandwidth across West African universities, modern academic software must support offline synchronization using client-side browser storage and service worker background syncing.
